[[Café Cabin]] }} '''Suffering Psyduck''' (Japanese: '''VS コダック''' ''VS Psyduck''), titled '''VS Psyduck''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 367th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 30th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''Psyduck and the Secret Potion''' (Japanese: '''コダックと秘伝の薬''' ''Koduck and the Secret Medicine'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Psyduck and the Elixirs''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} As {{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Platinum}} continue to [[Mount Coronet|Mt. Coronet]], the three decide to stop at the {{si|Pokémon Mansion}} after Platinum mistakes it for a hotel. The owner of the mansion, [[Mr. Backlot]], gives them all a tour of the house and the [[Trophy Garden]]. While Platinum is treated kindly by Mr. Backlot's staff, and even given a [[Soothe Bell]], Diamond and Pearl find themselves unwelcome. They decide to let Platinum go off on her own to explore the garden, and lend her [[Chimler]] and [[Tru]] to provide her protection. Diamond and Pearl head back inside the building to practice their routine. They are surprised to find Mr. Backlot speaking with [[Cynthia]]. Cynthia is happy to see the two, and is impressed to look through the window to find Platinum walking with the fully evolved versions of the Pokémon she had seen the trio train with. When the boys ask Cynthia why she is visiting the mansion, she explains that Mr. Backlot has requested her help in clearing up the swarm of {{p|Psyduck}} on {{rt|210|Sinnoh}} so that people can visit [[Amity Square]]. Platinum arrives just in time to hear Cynthia's plan, and volunteers to help. Cynthia sets the three on her {{p|Garchomp}} as she hops on a [[bicycle]] alongside them. To Diamond's shock, she says she wants to race Garchomp to Route 210. After they dash to their destination, Diamond is wheezing and disoriented while Pearl easily gets to his feet. From her bicycle, Cynthia removes a container with an attached hose. She informs the others that the container is filled with a [[Secret Medicine|Secret Potion]]. Telling the Psyduck to open their mouths, Cynthia uses the hose to spray the medicine over them. The swarm of Psyduck slowly clears the road, and Cynthia spots a Psyduck among them that had gone missing from a {{pkmn|Trainer}}. She realizes that the congestion of Psyduck must have been caused by a person. Now that the road is unblocked, Cynthia points out [[Café Cabin]] nearby. She walks over to it, thinking of her [[Professor Carolina|grandmother]] who loves the [[Moomoo Milk]] that is sold there. Right as she steps onto the porch, an old woman calls out to her, and Cynthia is shocked to see her grandmother right in front of her. Cynthia’s grandmother asks the four if they would like to hear {{DL|Sinnoh myths|Sinnoh's Myth|the legend of the Sinnoh lakes}}. ==Major events== * {{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Platinum}} meet [[Cynthia]] again. * Diamond, Pearl, Platinum, and Cynthia make the {{p|Psyduck}} move and find the missing Psyduck. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Mr. Backlot]] * [[Professor Carolina|Cynthia's grandmother]] ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Pearl}} * {{adv|Platinum}} * [[Cynthia]] * [[Professor Carolina|Cynthia's grandmother]] * [[Mr. Backlot]] * {{tc|Maid}}s * {{tc|Policeman|Guard}} * {{tc|Gentleman|Gentlemen}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munchlax}} ({{adv|Lax}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Grotle}} ([[Tru]]/{{tt|Wig|Chuang Yi}} {{adv|Diamond}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Torterra}} ([[Tru]]/{{tt|Wig|Chuang Yi}} {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Monferno}} ([[Chimler]]/{{tt|Chimhiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Infernape}} ([[Chimler]]/{{tt|Chimhiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Prinplup}} ({{OP|Platinum|Prinplup}}; flashback) * {{p|Empoleon}} ({{OP|Platinum|Empoleon}}) * {{p|Garchomp}} ({{OP|Cynthia|Garchomp}}) * {{p|Chingling}} ([[Professor Carolina|Cynthia's grandmother]]'s) * {{p|Psyduck}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Buneary}} (Trainer's; flashback) * {{p|Happiny}} (Trainer's; flashback) * {{p|Pichu}} (Trainer's; flashback) * {{p|Psyduck}} (multiple) * {{p|Pichu}} (multiple) * {{p|Starly}} (multiple) * {{p|Pikachu}} (multiple) * {{p|Roselia}} (multiple) * {{p|Kricketune}} (multiple) * {{p|Azelf}} ({{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Azelf|Adventures}}; fantasy) * {{p|Uxie}} ({{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Uxie|Adventures}}; fantasy) * {{p|Mesprit}} ({{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Mesprit|Adventures}}; fantasy) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FFCCCC|bordercolor=9999FF |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 可達鴨|VS Psyduck}} (Taiwan)
